headline: American Airlines Forecasts 2026 Loss as Fuel Costs Outpace Fare Gains
summary: American Airlines warned it expects a financial loss for 2026. The carrier noted that rising jet fuel expenses are outpacing gains from passenger airfares.
why: American Airlines is one of the largest global airlines, making its earnings outlook a primary indicator for passenger travel demand and jet fuel cost pressures.

impacts.name: American Airlines Group Inc
impacts.why: Fuel expense inflation outstripping ticket price increases strains profitability projections.

why_moved: A loss forecast directly reduces market expectations for profitability, weighing on market valuation.
